scanNote:
WORKBOOK 3-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (12-bet). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 3', yonida katta qora 'Shop till you Drop!'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1) 'a) Look at the pictures and name the shops. b) Which of the items in the list can you get at each place? Make sentences as in the example.' Qiya ro'yxat: 'chocolates, television, silver ring, haircut, sofa, cereal, tulips, sweets, tablets, lettuce, aspirin, red roses, oranges, diamond earrings, steak, manicure, washing-up liquid, sausages'. 9 SURAT: 1 shokolad peshtaxtasi ortidagi ayol (...chocolates, sweets... berilgan); 2 apelsin va ananaslar rastasi; 3 vitrinada taqinchoq tanlayotgan juftlik; 4 gul rastasi va gulfurush; 5 mijozning sochini yuvayotgan ayol; 6 supermarketda aravacha va bolali ayol; 7 qutilar terilgan javonlar (univermag); 8 oq xalat va chiziqli fartukli ayol go'sht peshtaxtasida; 9 galstukli erkak dori qutilari oldida. Qiya namuna: 'You can get chocolates and sweets at a confectioner's.'

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Match the clothes in the list to the people in the pictures, and fill in the table. Then, talk about what each person is wearing.' Qiya: 'socks, shoes, skirt, jeans, tie, jumper, shirt, jacket, hat, trousers, blouse'. 3 SURAT: Jill (maktab formasidagi qiz: qora pidjak, oq bluzka, yubka, oq paypoq, qora tufli); Matt (kostyum-shimli erkak: pidjak, shim, ko'ylak, galstuk, tufli, portfel); Michelle (jinsi shim, jemper, shlyapa, kurtka, sumkali qiz). JADVAL: Jill: socks, ...; Matt: trousers, ...; Michelle: jeans, ... Qiya namuna: 'Jill is wearing socks,...'
3) 'Fill in the correct preposition.' Qiya: 'of, on, to, at, with, in, for, along'. 1 Her skirt has blue flowers ...... it. 2 My umbrella is blue ...... a wooden handle. 3 Galleries Lafayette is the biggest department store ...... Paris. 4 The chairman ...... Harrods is Mohamed Al Fayed. 5 I went ...... Leonidas to buy some chocolates. 6 I'll meet you ...... one thirty tomorrow. 7 I'll wait ...... you if you want to try it on. 8 There are bookstalls ...... the banks of the River Seine.
• 'Grammar':
4) 'Underline the adjectives in the sentences, then write F for fact adjectives or O for opinion adjectives, as in the example.' 1 She lives in a big house. ...F... 2 He bought a lovely jacket last weekend. 3 I had a wonderful time last night. 4 My father is an old man now. 5 He has got green eyes. 6 'Romeo and Juliet' is an excellent play.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '12'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and name the shops.
exercises.explanationUz:
DO'KONLAR (coursebook 18-bet
  1-mashq).

  ⚠ Ko'p do'kon nomi 'S bilan:
  confectioner'S, greengrocer'S,
  jeweller'S, florist'S, butcher'S,
  chemist'S = '... ning do'koni'.


SURATLAR:

  1 shokolad peshtaxtasi →
    confectioner's
  2 apelsin, ananas → greengrocer's
  3 taqinchoq vitrinasi → jeweller's
  4 gul rastasi → florist's
  5 soch yuvish → hair & beauty
    salon (hairdresser's)
  6 aravacha, javonlar → supermarket
  7 katta javonlar, qutilar →
    department store
  8 fartukli ayol, go'sht → butcher's
  9 dori qutilari → chemist's


⚠ 'A BUTCHER'S':

  = qassob do'koni. 'a butcher' =
  qassob.


⚠ 'A CHEMIST'S':

  = dorixona (Brit.). AQSh:
  'drugstore', 'pharmacy'.


⚠ 'A DEPARTMENT STORE':

  = univermag (ko'p bo'limli katta
  do'kon - Harrods kabi).

items.whyUz: ⚠ Shokolad va konfet → shirinlik do'koni. NAMUNA.
⚠ Soch va go'zallik saloni ('hairdresser's' ham to'g'ri).
⚠ Televizor, divan kabi turli mollar → univermag.

items.hintUz: Oq xalat va fartukli ayol, go'sht peshtaxtasi

exercises.instructionEn: Which of the items in the list can you get at each place? Make sentences as in the example: chocolates, television, silver ring, haircut, sofa, cereal, tulips, sweets, tablets, lettuce, aspirin, red roses, oranges, diamond earrings, steak, manicure, washing-up liquid, sausages. Example: You can get chocolates and sweets at a confectioner's.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi qaysi narsalarni har bir joydan olish mumkin? Namunadagidek gaplar tuzing: chocolates, television, silver ring, haircut, sofa, cereal, tulips, sweets, tablets, lettuce, aspirin, red roses, oranges, diamond earrings, steak, manicure, washing-up liquid, sausages. Namuna: Shokolad va konfetlarni shirinlik do'konidan olish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
18 NARSA - 9 DO'KON (har biriga
  2 tadan).

  QOLIP: 'You can get X and Y at
  a + DO'KON.'
  ⚠ 'AT a shop' - predlog 'at'.


⚠ 'GET' = SOTIB OLMOQ / XIZMAT
  OLMOQ:

  'get a haircut' = soch oldirmoq
  'get a manicure' = manikyur
  qildirmoq - bular XIZMAT, mol
  emas, shuning uchun 'buy' emas,
  'get'.


⚠ 'CEREAL':

  = quruq nonushta (don mahsuloti).
  /ˈsɪəriəl/ - 'serial' bilan bir
  xil o'qiladi!


⚠ 'WASHING-UP LIQUID':

  = idish yuvish suyuqligi.


⚠ 'TABLETS' / 'ASPIRIN':

  tablets = tabletkalar
  aspirin = aspirin.


⚠ 'STEAK':

  = bifshteks (go'sht bo'lagi).
  /steɪk/ - 'stake' kabi.


⚠ 'LETTUCE':

  = salat bargi. /ˈletɪs/ ('letyus'
  EMAS!).

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA: 'You can get chocolates and sweets at a confectioner's.'
⚠ 'You can get oranges and lettuce at a greengrocer's.'
⚠ 'You can get a silver ring and diamond earrings at a jeweller's.'
⚠ 'You can get tulips and red roses at a florist's.'
⚠ 'You can get a haircut and a manicure at a hair & beauty salon.' - XIZMATLAR.
⚠ 'You can get cereal and washing-up liquid at a supermarket.'
⚠ 'You can get a television and a sofa at a department store.'
⚠ 'You can get steak and sausages at a butcher's.'
⚠ 'You can get tablets and aspirin at a chemist's.'

exercises.instructionEn: Match the clothes in the list to the people in the pictures, and fill in the table. Then, talk about what each person is wearing: socks, shoes, skirt, jeans, tie, jumper, shirt, jacket, hat, trousers, blouse. Jill: socks, ... Matt: trousers, ... Michelle: jeans, ... Example: Jill is wearing socks, ...
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi kiyimlarni suratdagi odamlarga moslang va jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng har bir kishi nima kiyganini ayting: socks, shoes, skirt, jeans, tie, jumper, shirt, jacket, hat, trousers, blouse. Jill: socks, ... Matt: trousers, ... Michelle: jeans, ... Namuna: Jill paypoq kiygan, ...
exercises.explanationUz:
KIYIMLAR (coursebook 22-bet
  23-mashq).

  JILL (maktab formasi): socks,
    shoes, skirt, blouse, jacket
  MATT (kostyum): trousers, shirt,
    tie, jacket, shoes
  MICHELLE (kundalik): jeans,
    jumper, hat, jacket

  ⚠ 'jacket' va 'shoes' - bir
  nechta odamda.


⚠ 'TO BE WEARING':

  'Jill is wearing socks' - HOZIR
  kiyib turibdi → continuous.


⚠ KO'PLIK KIYIMLAR:

  socks, shoes, jeans, trousers -
  HAR DOIM KO'PLIK ('a pair of
  jeans').


⚠ 'A JUMPER':

  Brit. = jemper, sviter (AQSh
  'sweater').


⚠ 'A BLOUSE' / 'A SHIRT':

  blouse = ayollar ko'ylagi
  shirt = erkaklar ko'ylagi.


⚠ 'A SKIRT':

  = yubka. 'shirt' bilan
  adashtirmang!

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'Jill is wearing socks, shoes, a skirt, a blouse and a jacket.'
⚠ 'Matt is wearing trousers, a shirt, a tie, a jacket and shoes.'
⚠ 'Michelle is wearing jeans, a jumper, a hat and a jacket.'

exercises.instructionEn: Talk about what each person is wearing.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir kishi nima kiyganini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  [ISM] is wearing + kiyimlar.

  ⚠ Ko'plik kiyim artiklsiz (socks,
  jeans), birlik kiyim 'a' bilan
  (a skirt, a tie).
modelAnswers: Jill is wearing socks, shoes, a skirt, a blouse and a jacket.
Matt is wearing trousers, a shirt, a tie, a jacket and shoes.
Michelle is wearing jeans, a jumper, a hat and a jacket.
modelAnswersUz: Jill paypoq, tufli, yubka, bluzka va pidjak kiygan.
Matt shim, ko'ylak, galstuk, pidjak va tufli kiygan.
Mishel jinsi shim, jemper, shlyapa va kurtka kiygan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition: of, on, to, at, with, in, for, along.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying: of, on, to, at, with, in, for, along.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR (coursebook 19-bet
  10-mashq - 'Exotic Shopping in
  Paris' matnidan).

  flowers ON it     - ustida
  blue WITH a handle - ... li
  the biggest IN Paris - Parijda
  the chairman OF   - ... ning raisi
  went TO Leonidas  - ... ga bordi
  meet you AT one thirty - soatda
  wait FOR you      - kutmoq
  ALONG the banks   - qirg'oq
    bo'ylab


⚠ 'WAIT FOR':

  'wait' dan keyin HAR DOIM 'for'.


⚠ 'AT' + VAQT:

  'at one thirty', 'at 5 o'clock'.


⚠ 'A CHAIRMAN':

  = rais. Mohamed Al Fayed -
  Harrods egasi (1985-2010).


⚠ 'TO TRY ON':

  = kiyib ko'rmoq.


⚠ 'A WOODEN HANDLE':

  = yog'och dasta.


⚠ 'THE BANKS OF THE RIVER':

  'a bank' = daryo qirg'og'i (bank
  ham!). Sena (Seine) - Parij
  daryosi.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the adjectives in the sentences, then write F for fact adjectives or O for opinion adjectives, as in the example. Example: She lives in a big house. - F
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplardagi sifatlarning tagiga chizing, so'ng fakt sifatlari uchun F, fikr sifatlari uchun O yozing, namunadagidek. Namuna: She lives in a big house. - F
exercises.explanationUz:
FAKT va FIKR SIFATLARI
  (coursebook 20-bet qoidasi).

  FAKT (F) - o'lchash/ko'rish
  mumkin, hamma rozi:
    big, old, green, small, round,
    wooden
  FIKR (O) - shaxsiy baho, boshqa
  odam boshqacha o'ylashi mumkin:
    lovely, wonderful, excellent,
    beautiful, nice


⚠ TARTIB: FIKR + FAKT:

  'a lovely old house' (fikr →
  fakt). Coursebook 20-bet 12-
  mashq.


GAPLARDAGI SIFATLAR:

  1 big → F (o'lcham)
  2 lovely → O (baho)
  3 wonderful → O (baho)
  4 old → F (yosh)
  5 green → F (rang)
  6 excellent → O (baho)


⚠ 'A PLAY':

  = pyesa, spektakl. 'Romeo and
  Juliet' - Shekspir pyesasi.

items.textEn: She lives in a big house. (big)
He bought a lovely jacket last weekend. (lovely)
items.uz: U o'tgan dam olish kuni chiroyli kurtka sotib oldi.
